verdict.label: BUY MEDIUM — DELL +39% Vindicates AI Capex; Iran MoU Language Gap Remains; Protect-the-Run
verdict.rationale_short: DELL's 39% surge on Q1 FY2027 earnings — reversing the initial −3.93% AH dip in hours, not weeks — is the most definitive AI capex validation in this series and explicitly invalidates the sell-the-news narrative. BUY thesis holds at medium conviction: VIX 15.74 and DXY 99.30 are both below triggers, PCE binary is resolved, DELL guidance raise ($165–169B from $138–142B) confirms AI server supercycle durability. Three caps on conviction upgrade: (1) Iran MoU still unsigned — VP Vance says 'TBD' over language points, and IRGC navy fired warning shots near the Strait of Hormuz on May 29; (2) 30Y still testing the 5.05% trigger after an intraday breach Thursday; (3) month-end Friday at S&P's 21st record of 2026 — rebalancing flows are a known seller of equities into the close.

bear_case: DELL's 39% gap-up has created a new AI infrastructure crowding risk: every institutional desk that was underweight or short the sector is now forced to cover into a single price level, concentrating buying in a way that historically exhausts at the wrong moment. IRGC warning shots near the Strait of Hormuz on May 29 are not the MoU ratification — if Trump rejects the deal over the nuclear stockpile language cited by Vance, Brent spikes to $97–100 overnight, the 30Y breaks above 5.10% on stagflation re-pricing, and the AI infrastructure rally faces a simultaneous rate-shock and oil-shock headwind. If SPX loses 7,460 on a daily close and the 30Y closes above 5.10%, the BUY call converts to Step Aside immediately.
